description: Na₇MgSbO₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.44 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.45 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.61-3.00 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.56 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.60 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.45 Å. Mg is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 1.95 Å. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. All Sb-O bond lengths are 2.04 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mg atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mg atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mg atom.
